content.comment_body: It appears that [product_name] [version_no] has certain issues. In multiple projects, when source files created with [version_no] are opened using an earlier version like [version_no], hardware changeover becomes problematic. For example, the source file selects hardware type [article_no] under [version_no]. The error message "Failed to load the panel" is displayed, and confirming it leads to varied outcomes depending on the specific program. I tried opening the program in [version_no] and encountered an initial error, after which modifications such as deleting blocks and adding UDFs were made, ending up in [version_no]. In both simulation and actual [product_name] [article_no] hardware, the program logic runs without errors, but hardware selection remains unavailable.

analysis.insight_summary: The user describes recurring compatibility problems when using project files from a newer version of [product_name] with earlier versions, particularly issues with hardware selection and UI errors like panel loading failures. Although the core program logic functions correctly in both test and real hardware environments, version mismatch causes configuration frustrations and disrupts workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable compatibility across [product_name] versions, specifically the ability to open and work with projects—including hardware re-selection—created in newer software versions when using previous releases.
